note: Reference notes about AI tools for Pip. Interfaces change: Pip trusts what is on screen over these notes.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.summary: OpenAI's general AI assistant for writing, questions, files, images and voice.
tools.access: Free plan; more with a paid plan
start: Open chatgpt.com in your browser (or install the app).
Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
Type what you need in the message box at the bottom and press Return.
Use the + button beside the box to add a file or picture.
features: Reads files, PDFs and pictures you add
Projects and custom GPTs keep instructions for repeated work

tools.name: Claude
tools.summary: Anthropic's AI assistant, strong at long documents, careful writing and code.
tools.access: Free plan; more with a paid plan
start: Open claude.ai in your browser (or install the app).
Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
Type your request in the box and press Return.
Use the paperclip or + button to add documents.

Artifacts: documents and small apps beside the chat

tools.name: Gemini

Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
Sign in with your Google account.
Type in the Ask Gemini box and press Return.
features: Works with Gmail, Docs, Drive and Maps
Gems: saved assistants with your instructions

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot

tools.access: Free plan available
start: Open copilot.microsoft.com in your browser (or install the app).
Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
Type or speak your question in the message box.

tools.name: Grok

start: Open grok.com in your browser (or install the app).
Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
Sign in with X, Google, Apple or email.
Type your question in the box; turn on search modes from the options beside it.

Voice mode in the mobile app

tools.name: DeepSeek

tools.name: Perplexity

start: Open perplexity.ai in your browser (or install the app).

Type a question and press Return.

tools.name: Notion

Gemini side panel in Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drive

tools.summary: Copilot inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams for drafting, analysing and summarising.

Click the Copilot button on the Home tab (or the Copilot icon).
Type what you want, for example 'summarise this document', and review the result.

Slides from a document in PowerPoint

tools.name: Excel
tools.summary: Microsoft's spreadsheet app, with Copilot for formulas, charts and analysis.

Click a blank workbook or open your file.
Select your data, then use the Home or Insert tab, or Copilot on the Home tab.

tools.name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)

Ask questions in the chat; answers cite your sources.

Study guides, flashcards and mind maps

tools.name: Slack AI
tools.summary: AI in Slack that summarises channels and threads and answers questions from your workspace.

Ask a question in the search bar to get an AI answer from your workspace.

Turn on the meeting summary, then find it after the meeting in your Zoom account or email.

tools.name: Otter.ai

start: Open otter.ai in your browser (or install the app).

Connect your calendar so Otter can join meetings, or press Record for a live conversation.
Open the transcript afterwards to see the summary and action items.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai

start: Open fireflies.ai in your browser (or install the app).

Read the summary and search the transcript afterwards.

tools.name: ClickUp Brain

tools.name: Motion

start: Open usemotion.com in your browser (or install the app).

tools.name: Zapier

tools.access: Free plan; more with a paid plan
start: Open zapier.com in your browser (or install the app).
Sign in or create an account; most offer Google, Microsoft or Apple sign-in.
